title: SU(3) Braided Fusion Spin Systems and Haah Nets
exact_target: Prove the stated local-net identification between the level-one fusion spin system and Haah's two-dimensional clock-and-shift net.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006354 (OWR-14299511-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Subfactors and Applications (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/34, pp. 1823--1886. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The specified source generators, local relations and braiding choice must be matched; an abstract isomorphism without a uniform locality bound is insufficient.
